invariants.rationale: The method expects a non-null execution context; passing null would likely violate API contracts.
An 'instant time' parameter is typically a required string value referencing the current commit, and is likely to be a non-empty string.
The method requires a list of records to upsert, so it must not be null.
If preppedRecords is not null, it should contain at least one record for the upsert to make sense.
